Questions

What does “Website redesign and migration” cost?
The MVP costs $3,000–8,000 (UZS 36–97 mln), the full version $10,000–25,000 (UZS 120–305 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Website redesign and migration” take?
The MVP takes 3–6 weeks, the full version 8–14 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
Domain and hosting access; Texts, photos and the logo; One person who makes the decisions.
